cues.text: Carmen. It's me. I know it's late. Somebody's taken one of the discs out of the channel. The wear marks are fresh. It isn't conservation.
And it isn't a calendar either. I've been reading it wrong for a year. It's a door, Carmen. And someone's opening it.
I'm driving down now. Don't smoke all of them before I get there. Te quiero.
There's cloud on the road, doctora. Stay.
There's always cloud on the road.
Radio Las Palmas. Still awake. Someone has to be.
The camp lights, going out one by one. Rayco's still up. He never sleeps.
Seven circles in a line. One shaded empty. Six. There should be seven.
Static. And under the static, surf. There's no surf up here.
Water on the inside of the glass. On the inside.
The doors. No. It's a door, Carmen. I told you it was a door.
There's no water in this barranco.
The Guardia Civil said it was a flash flood.
It hadn't rained on that side of the mountain for forty days.
